subject: Request: SLA exception & onboarding credit for AthenaHealth (RDW-1764)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA exception & onboarding credit for AthenaHealth (RDW-1764)

Team — placing an escalation to execs / deal desk for approval. Summary: AthenaHealth (POC Ben Turner) is ready to sign a 24-month committed package (3 reserved nodes, production) for a total ARR of $1.1M, but procurement is pushing back on the standard onboarding fees and wants premium support included for the first 12 months plus a one-time onboarding credit to offset internal integration costs.

Ask: Approve a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of year-1 ARR (approximately $110k) to be taken from upfront professional services revenue and include Premium Support for 12 months (they are asking for 24/7 response for Sev 1) at no additional charge for the first year. This exceeds our playbook (we typically allow up to 15% discount and 3 months premium support on strategic deals).

Why:
- Strategic logo in healthcare vertical; large potential expansion (estimated +3 additional teams over 18 months).
- They have a strict go-live timeline tied to a product launch (internal date: Aug 15).
- Their technical ask includes a custom connector to their FHIR gateway and two on-site workshops (SOW attached).

Impact / numbers (preliminary):
- List price: $1,100,000 ARR
- Standard onboarding & PS: $140,000 one-time
- Requested credit: $110,000 (10% of ARR)
- Net ARR retained: $990,000
- Estimated gross margin after credits / PS: ~48% (Priyom will confirm)

Attachments: SOW-Athena-2026.pdf (draft for PS scope), pricing-breakdown.xlsx (workup).

Risks: sets a precedent on credits/long premium support; however, legal has confirmed there are no data residency exceptions required. Recommend exec sign-off for one-time exception if Marissa / sales leadership agree. If approved, I'll prepare revised SOW + updated DocuSign.

Thanks — Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA exception & onboarding credit for AthenaHealth (RDW-1764)

Vanessa — thanks for the summary. A couple quick asks before I sign off to escalate: can Priyom confirm the margin math and whether the $110k credit can be structured as a phasing (e.g., $60k upfront credit + $50k credit amortized across year-1 invoices) to preserve cash flow? Also need to know whether the 12-month Premium Support request can be scoped as "Standard Premium for 3 months + Extended Monitoring for 9 months" to reduce risk.

Marissa — are you comfortable with a 10% onboarding concession for a first-year credit on a 24-month commit for a strategic healthcare account? If you want, I can route a formal deal desk memo once Priyom posts the numbers.

Karthik
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA exception & onboarding credit for AthenaHealth (RDW-1764)

Folks — updated numbers after modeling. See pricing-breakdown.xlsx (attached) for line-item math. TL;DR:
- List ARR: $1,100,000
- Proposed net ARR after $110k credit: $990,000
- Professional services revenue drop from $140k -> $30k (we absorb $110k as credit against PS invoice)
- Expected adjusted gross margin (first 12 months): 46% (including increased support cost)
- Cash impact: ~$85k upfront delta (we still net positive ARR and project payback within 15 months given expansion potential).

On the support / SLA: we can offer structured concession: 3 months full Premium (24/7 Sev1) + 9 months of "Premium Lite" monitoring and 8-hour response for Sev1. If Athena insists on 12 months full Premium, cost delta is ~ $45k incremental. My recommendation: approve the 10% onboarding credit, and require the staged support profile (3 months full + 9 months lite). If they sign a 36-month extension clause in year 2 at standard rates, we can convert the remaining support delta into a credit.

I believe risk is manageable if Marissa approves the credit and we lock renewal terms/expansion SLA in the SOW.

- Priyom
Director, Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Turner <ben.turner@athenahealth.com>, AthenaHealth Procurement <procurement@athenahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: SLA exception & onboarding credit for AthenaHealth (RDW-1764)

Ben / Procurement — thanks for your patience while we reviewed internally. Good news: Sales leadership has approved a one-time onboarding credit equal to 10% of year-1 ARR ($110,000) and we will include an elevated support profile for the first 12 months with the following structure: 3 months Full Premium (24/7 Sev1) + 9 months Premium Lite (8-hour response for Sev1).

Conditions:
- Credit will be applied against the professional services invoice at signature.
- Athena must sign the attached SOW (SOW-Athena-2026.pdf) and the updated commercial schedule via DocuSign. Link: https://www.docusign.com/redirect?doc=RDW-1764-SOW
- Renewal commitment: At year-2 renewal, standard premium pricing applies unless a 36-month extends clause is executed (we will include an optional extension in the SOW).

Next steps: Vanessa to send revised SOW and DocuSign envelope by EOD today; requested signature within 5 business days to preserve pricing. Ben — can you confirm procurement will review the SOW and sign by next Wed (May 26)?

Thanks — excited to get Athena live.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
